newsitem.title: GERMANY: Wayss - wins 168 mln dmk Singapore contract.
newsitem.headline: Wayss - wins 168 mln dmk Singapore contract.

text.p: German construction group Wayss & Freytag said on Thursday that it had won 45 percent of a contract to build a subway system in Singapore, with its share of the contract worth 168 million marks.
Wayss, which is majority-owned by Dutch builder Hollandsche Beton Groep NV, said that the total contract, worth 373 million marks, involved building two underground train stations.
Wayss is also involved in a $20 million project in Jakarta in Indonesia to build a business centre.
Wayss said that the two projects in the Asia-Pacific region means that it can further develop its foreign business, as is its stated aim.
